exposure: Screening and diagnosis of GDM with one-step IADPSGC vs. traditional two-step Carpenter-Coustan (CC) criteria
International Association of the Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups criteria (IADPSGC)
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 1,750 pregnant women screened for GDM using CC criteria and 1,526 pregnant women screened using IADPSGC
finding: The application of the new IADPSGC was associated with a 3.5-fold increase in GDM prevalence, significant improvements in pregnancy outcomes, and was cost-effective.
